🍳 You learned to cook properly: a family restaurant kitchen, culinary school classes or years of feeding younger siblings.

🌱 Knife work, rice and stock, frying, baking and food safety. You can feed a dorm floor or hold a station in a restaurant kitchen.
⚠️ Fine dining, specialist cuisines and running a whole kitchen are beyond you.
⚖️ Selling food needs a food hygiene permit.
🏫 It shows in clean knife cuts, a tidy kitchen and a habit of feeding people who look tired.

📈 Grants: Cooking +15
